name: Sueca
summary: 4-player partnership trick-taking ace-ten game where teams race to 61 of 120 points with a trump suit.
rules_text: Played by 4 players in two partnerships sitting opposite with a 40-card deck (8s,9s,10s removed). Deal 10 cards each; next card face-up defines trump. Rank order high to low: Ace, 7, King, Jack, Queen, 6,5,4,3,2. Values: Ace 11, Seven 10, King 4, Jack 3, Queen 2. 120 points per deal. Player to dealer’s right leads first trick counter-clockwise. Must follow suit if possible; if void may play any card including trump. Highest trump wins trick, otherwise highest of led suit wins. Winner leads next. Team with >60 points wins one game; >90 points wins two games; all tricks or 120 points often wins the set instantly depending on variant. First team to 4 games wins the partida. No table talk in tournament rules.
rating_reason: Specific partnership ace-ten trick game, strategic
